tasks.description:
Write and execute Python code to tune the hyperparameters of the selected model using a grid search. Use the following code: 
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
# Load the dataset
credit_data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_card_approval.csv')
# Select the model and hyperparameters to tune
model = 'model_name'
hp_space = {'param1': [value1, value2], 'param2': [value3, value4]}
# Perform grid search
grid_search = GridSearchCV(model, hp_space, cv=5, scoring='f1_macro')
grid_search.fit(credit_data.drop('target', axis=1), credit_data['target'])
# Print the best hyperparameters and the corresponding score
print(grid_search.best_params_) 
print(grid_search.best_score_)
tasks.expected_output: The best hyperparameters and the corresponding F1 score.

tasks.description:
Write and execute Python code to evaluate the performance of the trained model on the dataset. Use the following code: 
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
# Load the dataset
credit_data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_card_approval.csv')
# Split the data into training and testing sets
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(credit_data.drop('target', axis=1), credit_data['target'], test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
# Train the model
model = 'model_name'
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
# Make predictions on the testing set
y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
# Print the model's performance metrics
print('Accuracy:', accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))
print('F1 Score:', f1_score(y_test, y_pred))
print('Precision:', precision_score(y_test, y_pred))
print('Recall:', recall_score(y_test, y_pred))
tasks.expected_output: The model's performance metrics, including accuracy, F1 score, precision, and recall.
